                                 API Endpoints Used
                            

                            
                        

                        

                            
                            

                                

                                    GET
                                    Fetch Fusion Credentials
                                

                                .../WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trip/fusionuserdetails?p_instance_name={instance}
                                
Retrieves Fusion Cloud username/password for authenticated API calls

                            


                            
                            

                                

                                    GET
                                    Fetch Transactions for Auto Processing
                                

                                .../WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trips/transactionforautopr?P_FROM_DATE={date}&P_TO_DATE={date}&P_INSTANCE_NAME={instance}
                                
Fetches pending inventory transactions grouped by trip for the given date range

                            


                            
                            

                                

                                    POST
                                    Process S2V Auto (per LID)
                                

                                .../WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trip/processs2vauto/{LID}?p_instance_name={instance}
                                
Processes a single inventory transaction by its LID (Line ID). Called sequentially for each line.

                            


                            
                            

                                

                                    POST
                                    Cancel S2V Lot (per LID)
                                

                                .../TRIPMANAGEMENT/trip/cancels2vlot/{LID}?p_instance_name={instance}
                                
Cancels a specific inventory transaction line by its LID

                            


                            
                            

                                

                                    GET
                                    Fusion Cloud - Get Staged Transactions
                                    Authenticated
                                

                                https://efmh{-test}.fa.em3.oraclecloud.com/fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/inventoryStagedTransactions?q=OrganizationName=GIC;TransactionTypeName=Direct Organization Transfer
                                
Fetches staged inventory transactions from Oracle Fusion Cloud. Uses Basic Auth. TEST: efmh-test.fa.em3.oraclecloud.com | PROD: efmh.fa.em3.oraclecloud.com

                            


                            
                            

                                

                                    DELETE
                                    Fusion Cloud - Delete Staged Transaction
                                    Authenticated
                                

                                https://efmh{-test}.fa.em3.oraclecloud.com/fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/inventoryStagedTransactions/{TransactionInterfaceId}
                                
Deletes a staged transaction from Fusion Cloud after successful processing. Uses Basic Auth. TEST: efmh-test | PROD: efmh

 System Architecture Overview

                                
The WMS (Warehouse Management System) is built on a robust three-tier architecture that seamlessly integrates Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle APEX, and a high-performance C# WebView2 application to deliver a unified warehouse management experience.


                                
                                

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            
Layer 1: Oracle Fusion Cloud

                                            Data Source
                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Sales Orders
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Customers
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Items & Inventory
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    On-Hand Quantities
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Pending Shipments
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Lot Details
                                                

                                            

                                            
Oracle Fusion is the enterprise ERP system containing all master data including sales orders, customer information, item catalogs, inventory levels, and shipment details.

                                        

                                    


                                    

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            REST APIs
                                        

                                        

                                    


                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            
Layer 2: Oracle APEX (Database)

                                            Processing Layer
                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Trips
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Lorries/Vehicles
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Pickers
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Assignments
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Store Requests
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Print Jobs
                                                

                                            

                                            
APEX serves as the operational database layer, storing trip assignments, vehicle allocations, picker assignments, and processing queues for optimized performance.

                                        

                                    


                                    

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            REST APIs
                                        

                                        

                                    


                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            
Layer 3: WMS Application

                                            User Interface
                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    HTML5/CSS3
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    JavaScript
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    C# WebView2
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    DevExpress
                                                

                                            

                                            
The WMS desktop application built with C# and WebView2, providing a responsive HTML/CSS/JavaScript interface with DevExpress components for rich data grids.

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                
 Key Architectural Benefits

                                

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                        

                                        
High Performance

                                        
Multi-threaded architecture runs concurrent API calls for data fetching, ensuring lightning-fast response times even with large datasets.

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                        

                                        
Real-Time Data

                                        
Direct integration with Oracle Fusion APIs ensures real-time data synchronization without any integration delays or data staleness.

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                        

                                        
Data Integrity

                                        
By using native Fusion APIs, all transactions maintain complete data integrity with built-in validation and audit trails.

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                        

                                        
No Integration Overhead

                                        
Eliminates third-party integration tools and middleware, reducing complexity and potential points of failure.

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                        

                                        
Modern Technology Stack

                                        
Built on solid C#, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript foundations, ensuring maintainability and extensibility.

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                        

                                        
Unified View

                                        
Aggregates data from both Fusion and APEX into a single screen, giving users complete visibility without switching systems.

                                    

                                


                                
                                
 Data Flow Process

                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
Order Fetching

                                            
WMS fetches pending shipments (orders) from Oracle Fusion Cloud in real-time.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Local Caching

                                            
Orders are stored in APEX database for faster processing and trip management.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Trip Creation

                                            
Users create trips and assign orders, pickers, and lorries through WMS interface.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                    

                                        
4

                                        

                                            
Execution

                                            
WMS executes Fusion APIs for pick release, lot allocation, and transaction processing.

 Print Job Workflow

                                

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
1. User Action

                                                
Click "Print Order" button

                                            

                                        


                                        


                                        
                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
2. Create Job

                                                
JS sends to C# Router

                                            

                                        


                                        


                                        
                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
3. Download PDF

                                                
Fusion SOAP Report

                                            

                                        


                                        


                                        
                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
4. Send to Printer

                                                
Windows Print Spooler

                                            

                                        


                                        


                                        
                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
5. Update Status

                                                
APEX DB & UI Grid

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        

                                            
1

                                            

                                                
 User Initiates Print

                                                
User clicks "Print Order" button from Trip Details or Monitor Printing page

                                                

                                                     Select orders
                                                     Choose printer
                                                     Set copies
                                                

                                            

                                        


                                        

                                            
2

                                            

                                                
 JavaScript Processes Request

                                                
sendMessageToCSharp() creates print job and routes to C# backend

                                                

                                                     Validate input
                                                     Build payload
                                                     Route message
                                                

                                            

                                        


                                        

                                            
3

                                            

                                                
 Download PDF from Fusion

                                                
FusionPdfDownloader calls Oracle SOAP/XMLP service to generate report

                                                

                                                     SOAP request
                                                     Generate report
                                                     Save locally
                                                

                                            

                                        


                                        

                                            
4

                                            

                                                
 Send to Physical Printer

                                                
PrinterService sends PDF to Windows Print Spooler for physical output

                                                

                                                     Load printer
                                                     Queue job
                                                     Print document
                                                

                                            

                                        


                                        

                                            
5

                                            

                                                
 Update Status & Notify

                                                
Update APEX database and refresh UI grid with completion status

                                                

                                                     Update DB
                                                     Refresh grid
                                                     Show toast

Detailed Feature List by Module


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Trip Management

                                        Main Module - 15 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Instance Selection (PROD/TEST)
                                                
Toggle between Production and Test Oracle Fusion environments. All API calls dynamically switch endpoints based on selected instance, allowing safe testing without affecting production data.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Date Range Selection
                                                
Filter trips by date range using DevExpress DateBox controls. Supports single date, date range, and quick presets (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days). Dates are passed to APEX APIs for server-side filtering.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                All Trips Grid
                                                
DevExpress DataGrid showing all trips with columns: Order Number, Trip ID, Trip Date, Lorry, Status, Picker, Customer, Weight. Supports sorting, filtering, grouping, and column reordering.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Multi-Select Lorry Filter
                                                
Advanced dropdown with checkboxes to filter by multiple lorries simultaneously. Shows selected count badge and supports "Select All" / "Clear All" actions.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Multi-Select Date Filter
                                                
Filter by multiple specific dates. Useful for comparing trips across different days or analyzing weekly patterns.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                KPI Summary Bar
                                                
Real-time statistics showing: Total Orders, Total Trips, Unique Customers, Lorries Used, Pickers Assigned, and Total Weight. Updates automatically when filters change.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Bulk Picker Assignment
                                                
Select multiple rows in grid and assign a picker to all selected orders at once. Opens modal with picker dropdown, shows selected orders count, and calls APEX pickerassignment API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Bulk Lot Allocation
                                                
Allocate inventory lots to multiple selected orders. Calls APEX materialtrx/allocatelots API for each order and shows progress with success/failure counts.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Row Selection with Checkboxes
                                                
DevExpress selection column with header checkbox for "Select All". Selection state persists during filtering. Selected rows highlighted with visual feedback.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Export to Excel
                                                
Export filtered grid data to Excel (.xlsx) format using DevExpress export functionality. Includes all visible columns with current sorting and grouping preserved.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Column Visibility Toggle
                                                
Show/hide columns using column chooser. User preferences can be saved for consistent experience across sessions.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Real-time Data Refresh
                                                
Refresh button to reload data from APEX API. Shows loading indicator during fetch and preserves current filter/sort state.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Status Color Coding
                                                
Visual status indicators with color-coded badges: Pending (yellow), In Progress (blue), Completed (green), Failed (red). Makes it easy to identify trip status at a glance.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Processing Indicator
                                                
Circular loading indicator in header showing active API calls. Displays count of concurrent requests and service names. Prevents UI interaction during critical operations.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Toast Notifications
                                                
Slide-in notifications for success, error, warning, and info messages. Auto-dismiss after 4 seconds with smooth animation. Color-coded by message type.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Trip Details

                                        Core Module - 12 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Floating Action Bar
                                                
Context-sensitive action bar that appears when a trip is selected. Contains quick actions: View Order Lines, Pick Release Details, Sales Order Lines, Lot Details, Shipment Details, Store Transactions. Positioned at bottom of screen for easy access.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Order Lines Modal
                                                
View detailed order lines from Oracle Fusion. Displays: Line Number, Item, Description, Ordered Qty, Shipped Qty, UOM, Unit Price, Extended Amount. Calls TRIPMANAGEMENT/trip/order/fetchfusionorderlines API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Pick Release Details Modal
                                                
Shows pick release status for order. Displays: Move Order Line, Pick Slip, Subinventory, Locator, Lot, Quantity Detailed, Quantity Delivered. Calls TRIPMANAGEMENT/trips/orders/getpickreleasedetails API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Sales Order Lines Modal
                                                
Full sales order line details from APEX. Shows: Line Status, Schedule Ship Date, Fulfillment Line, Source Order. Calls TRIPMANAGEMENT/trip/orders/getsalesorderlines API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Lot Details Modal
                                                
Inventory lot information with allocation status. Shows: Lot Number, Expiry Date, Available Qty, Allocated Qty, Subinventory. Used for FIFO/FEFO lot allocation decisions.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Shipment Details Modal
                                                
Shipment header and line details. Shows: Delivery Name, Ship Method, Carrier, Tracking Number, Ship-to Location. Calls WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trips/orders/getshipmentdetails API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Store Transactions Modal
                                                
S2V transaction details with three tabs: Transaction Details, QOH (Quantity on Hand), Allocated Lots. Each tab calls separate API endpoints for detailed information.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Add Orders to Trip
                                                
Select pending orders and add them to existing trip. Opens modal showing available pending orders, allows multi-select, calls WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trips/addorders API to update trip.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Create New Trip
                                                
Create a new trip with selected orders. Modal allows: Trip Date selection, Lorry assignment, Order selection. Calls WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trips/create API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Pick Release Execution
                                                
Execute pick release for selected orders. Calls Oracle Fusion pick wave API through APEX proxy. Shows progress for each order with success/failure status. Updates grid after completion.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Get Order Volume/Weight
                                                
Fetch volume and weight metrics for selected order. Calls TRIPMANAGEMENT/fetchordervolume API. Displays: Total Volume (CBM), Total Weight (KG), Item Count, Pallet Count estimate.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Cancel Scheduled Lines
                                                
Cancel unpicked scheduled lines for an order. Opens confirmation modal, calls cancellation API, updates status in grid. Used when order changes or cancellation required.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Vehicles Dashboard

                                        5 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Vehicle Summary Cards
                                                
Card-based layout showing each vehicle with: Lorry Number, Assigned Route, Driver Name, Capacity (Volume/Weight), Current Trip Count, Order Count. Cards are color-coded by utilization level.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Date Merge Option
                                                
Toggle to consolidate vehicle data across selected date range. When enabled, shows aggregate totals instead of per-day breakdown. Useful for weekly/monthly vehicle utilization analysis.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Vehicle Capacity Utilization
                                                
Visual progress bars showing capacity utilization percentage. Green (0-70%), Yellow (70-90%), Red (90-100%). Helps identify under/over-utilized vehicles.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Click-to-Filter Integration
                                                
Click on a vehicle card to filter the main Trips grid by that lorry. Provides seamless navigation between vehicle overview and trip details.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Debug Data View
                                                
Developer toggle to show raw JSON data for troubleshooting. Displays API response structure, data types, and values. Accessible via hidden keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+D).

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Analytics

                                        5 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Real-time KPI Cards
                                                
Dashboard cards showing: Total Orders, Total Trips, Unique Customers, Lorries Used, Pickers Assigned, Total Weight (KG). Cards update in real-time as filters change. Each card shows current value and trend indicator.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Advanced Multi-Select Filters
                                                
Filter by multiple Customers, Lorries, and Pickers simultaneously. Each filter has search capability, "Select All" toggle, and shows selected count. Filters work in combination for precise data analysis.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Export to Excel
                                                
Export current filtered view to Excel (.xlsx) with all columns and data. Includes applied filter information in export metadata. Useful for external reporting and analysis.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Active Filters Chip Display
                                                
Visual chips showing all currently applied filters below the filter bar. Each chip shows filter name and value with X button to remove. Click chip to edit filter value directly.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Pickers Management

                                        4 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Picker CRUD Operations
                                                
Complete picker management: Add new pickers, Edit existing picker details, Delete inactive pickers. All operations call WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/pickers API endpoints with validation.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Picker Type Classification
                                                
Categorize pickers as: Bulk Picker (handles large volume orders), Individual Picker (handles single orders), Relief Picker (backup/overflow support). Type affects assignment algorithm priority.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Picker Profile Details
                                                
Comprehensive picker profile: Employee ID, Full Name, Contact Number, Email, Assigned Area/Zone, Profit Center, Category, Active Status. Supports profile photo upload.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Picker Performance View
                                                
View picker performance metrics: Orders Picked (today/week/month), Average Pick Time, Error Rate, Current Assignments. Helps optimize picker allocation decisions.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Monitor Printing

                                        8 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Print Statistics Dashboard
                                                
Real-time status cards showing: Total Jobs, Pending, Downloaded, Printing, Completed, Failed. Each card is color-coded and clickable to filter the job list. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Trip-Based Job Grouping
                                                
Print jobs grouped by Trip ID with expandable sections. Shows trip summary (order count, total pages) with toggle to expand/collapse individual orders. Quick print button for entire trip.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Auto-Print Configuration
                                                
Enable automatic printing per trip: Toggle switch to enable/disable, Printer selection dropdown, Print on status change option. Calls /monitor-printing/enable and /disable APIs.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                PDF Preview Modal
                                                
Full-screen PDF preview before printing. Uses getPdfAsBase64 to fetch PDF from APEX. Zoom controls, page navigation, download button. Can print directly from preview.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Batch Print Operations
                                                
"Print All" modal for bulk printing: Select orders to print, Choose printer, Set copies count, Progress bar during printing. Uses C# WebView bridge printOrder action.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Print Job Status Tracking
                                                
Track each job through stages: Pending → Downloaded → Printing → Completed/Failed. Timestamps for each stage transition. Retry button for failed jobs.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Printer Selection Per Job
                                                
Override default printer for specific jobs. Dropdown shows all configured printers from /printers/all API. Selected printer saved with job for consistency.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Print Job History
                                                
Historical view of all print jobs with filters: Date range, Status, Printer, Trip. Shows: Print Time, Duration, Pages, Printer Used. Export to Excel for audit.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Auto Inventory Processing

                                        Automation Module - 10 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Automated S2V Processing
                                                
Fully automated Store-to-Vehicle transaction processing. System fetches pending S2V transactions from TRIPMANAGEMENT/trip/PendingS2Vtransactions, processes each through Oracle Fusion inventoryStagedTransactions API, with automatic retry logic for transient failures.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Auto Processing Toggle
                                                
Master toggle to enable/disable automatic processing. When enabled, system polls for new transactions every 30 seconds. Visual indicator shows: Green (Active), Yellow (Paused), Red (Error). Processing can be paused without losing queue.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Transaction Status Tracking
                                                
Real-time status tracking with color-coded badges: Pending (gray), Processing (blue with spinner), Success (green), Failed (red), Cancelled (orange). Each status shows timestamp and duration. Click to view detailed transaction log.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Automatic Lot Allocation
                                                
System automatically fetches available lots from Oracle Fusion, applies FIFO/FEFO rules, and allocates to transactions. Calls WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trip/processs2vauto API which handles lot selection logic server-side.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                MRA Logging (Material Receipt Advice)
                                                
Complete audit trail for all S2V transactions. Logs: Transaction ID, Timestamp, User, Items, Lots, Quantities, Status, Fusion Response. Stored in APEX for compliance and troubleshooting. Exportable to Excel.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Fusion Credentials Management
                                                
Secure storage of Oracle Fusion credentials. Fetches from WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trip/fusionuserdetails API. Credentials used for Fusion API authentication (Basic Auth). Never exposed in browser console or network logs.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Transaction Cancellation
                                                
Cancel pending or failed transactions. Calls TRIPMANAGEMENT/trip/cancels2vlot API. Cancelled transactions removed from processing queue. Cancellation logged with reason and user.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Progress Dashboard
                                                
Visual dashboard showing: Total Transactions, Pending, Processing, Completed, Failed counts. Progress bar for current batch. Estimated completion time based on average processing speed.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Error Handling & Retry
                                                
Intelligent error handling: Network errors auto-retry (3 attempts with exponential backoff), Fusion errors logged with response, User notified of persistent failures. Failed transactions can be manually retried.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Batch Processing Configuration
                                                
Configure batch size (number of concurrent transactions), processing interval, date range filters, source organization filter. Settings saved to localStorage for persistence.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Auto Sales Order Processing

                                        Automation Module - 9 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Automated Pick Release
                                                
Execute pick release for multiple orders automatically. Calls TRIPMANAGEMENT/trip/pickrelease/oneorder API for each selected order. Shows progress modal with per-order status. Supports batch sizes to prevent API overload.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Trip-Based Order Grouping
                                                
Orders displayed grouped by Trip ID in expandable accordion sections. Each trip section shows: Trip ID, Order Count, Total Weight, Status Summary. Expand to see individual orders with details.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Bulk Picker Assignment
                                                
Assign picker to all orders in a trip at once. Opens picker selection modal with picker list from APEX. Calls WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trip/assignpicker API. Progress shown for each order assignment.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Scheduled Lines Cancellation
                                                
Cancel unpicked scheduled lines for selected orders. Shows confirmation with line count. Useful when orders change after scheduling. Updates Oracle Fusion directly through APEX proxy.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Order Selection Interface
                                                
Checkbox selection at both trip and order level. Select All / Deselect All for trips. Selection count shown in action bar. Selected orders highlighted with visual feedback.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Auto-Refresh with Polling
                                                
Optional auto-refresh to keep data current. Configurable polling interval (30s, 1m, 5m). Pause polling during user interaction. Resume automatically when idle.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Pick Release Preview
                                                
Preview orders before executing pick release. Shows: Order details, Expected warehouse tasks, Potential issues (insufficient inventory, holds). Allows deselection of problematic orders.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Processing Results Summary
                                                
After batch operation, shows summary: Total Processed, Successful, Failed with reasons. Failed orders listed with error messages. Option to retry failed orders only.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Printer Integration
                                                
Print pick lists after successful pick release. Fetches printer list from /printers/all API. Option to auto-print or queue for later. Uses same print infrastructure as Monitor Printing module.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Pending Store Transactions

                                        7 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                S2V Transaction Grid
                                                
DevExpress DataGrid showing all pending Store-to-Vehicle transactions. Columns: Transaction Number, Order, Item, Quantity, Lot, Status, Created Date. Supports sorting, filtering, grouping, and export.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Summary KPI Cards
                                                
Dashboard cards showing: Total Lines, Total Orders, Pending Count, Selected Count, Total Quantity. Cards update in real-time as data changes or filters are applied.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Source Organization Filter
                                                
Filter transactions by source organization (warehouse). Dropdown populated from unique values in data. Supports multi-select for comparing organizations.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Bulk Selection & Processing
                                                
Checkbox column for selecting multiple transactions. Action bar appears with selected count. Bulk actions: Process Selected, Assign Picker, Allocate Lots, Cancel Selected.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Lot Allocation Modal
                                                
View and allocate lots to transactions. Shows available lots with: Lot Number, Expiry Date, Available Qty, Subinventory. Manual allocation or auto-allocate with FIFO/FEFO rules.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Picker Assignment Modal
                                                
Assign picker to selected transactions. Shows picker list with: Name, Type, Current Load, Status. Assignment calls WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trip/assignpicker API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Fetch Lot Details
                                                
View detailed lot information for a transaction. Calls WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/trip/fetchlotdetails API. Shows: All available lots, Allocation history, QOH by subinventory.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Pending Shipment Lines

                                        5 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Shipment Lines Grid
                                                
DevExpress DataGrid showing pending shipment lines from Oracle Fusion. Columns: Delivery Name, Order Number, Item, Quantity, Ship-To Location, Carrier, Ship Date. Data fetched from WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/getpendingshipmentlines API.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Instance Toggle (PROD/TEST)
                                                
Switch between Production and Test environments. All API calls redirect to appropriate Fusion instance. Clearly indicates current instance with color-coded badge (Green=PROD, Orange=TEST).

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Date Range Filtering
                                                
Filter shipment lines by scheduled ship date range. DevExpress DateBox controls with calendar picker. Quick presets: Today, Tomorrow, This Week, Custom Range.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Export to Excel
                                                
Export filtered shipment line data to Excel (.xlsx). Includes all visible columns with current sorting. Useful for sharing with logistics partners or external analysis.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Add to Trip Integration
                                                
Select pending shipment lines and add to existing or new trip. Links to Trip Management module. Streamlines workflow from pending orders to trip creation.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Printer Setups

                                        4 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Printer CRUD Operations
                                                
Add, edit, and delete printer configurations. Form fields: Printer Name, Network Path/IP, Port, Description, Paper Size, Orientation. Saved to APEX via /config/printer API. Changes sync across all workstations.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Active Printer Selection
                                                
Set one printer as the default active printer. Radio button selection in printer list. Calls /printers/set-active API. Active printer used for all auto-print operations and as default in manual print dialogs.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Printer Connectivity Test
                                                
Test printer connection before saving. Uses C# WebView bridge testPrinter action. Shows result: Success (green checkmark), Failed (red X with error message). Validates network path and printer availability.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Printer Configuration Sync
                                                
Printer configurations stored centrally in APEX database. All workstations share same printer list. Local C# app caches printer list for offline operation. Sync on startup and periodic refresh.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
WMS Co-Pilot

                                        3 Features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Quick Actions Floating Panel
                                                
Floating action button (FAB) in bottom-right corner. Expands to show context-aware quick actions based on current page. Actions include: Create Trip, Assign Picker, Pick Release, Allocate Lots, View Process Flow. One-click execution of common workflows.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Process Flow Visualization
                                                
Visual representation of order processing stages. Shows: Order Created → Pick Released → Lots Allocated → Picked → Shipped. Current stage highlighted. Click stage to view details. Shows counts and status for each stage.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Trip Details Quick View
                                                
Expanded trip information panel accessible from Co-Pilot. Shows: Trip summary, All orders in trip, KPI metrics, Quick action buttons. Fetches data from WAREHOUSEMANAGEMENT/GETTRIPDETAILS API. Data cards for sales order lines, pick release details, lot details.
