 Business Processes

                                
Detailed documentation of the business processes implemented in WMS.


                                
                                

                                    
 Order to Delivery Process

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
1. Fetch Pending Orders

                                                
WMS fetches all pending shipments (sales orders) from Oracle Fusion Cloud.

                                                
    
                                                    
  • Filter by date range and instance
    • 
                                                    
  • Orders are stored in APEX for faster access
    • 
                                                    
  • Real-time sync ensures data accuracy
    • 
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
2. Create Trip

                                                
Create a new trip and assign orders, lorry, and date.

                                                
    
                                                    
  • Select orders from pending list
    • 
                                                    
  • Choose delivery vehicle (lorry)
    • 
                                                    
  • Set trip date and priority
    • 
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
3. Assign Picker

                                                
Assign a picker to the trip or individual orders.

                                                
    
                                                    
  • Select from available pickers
    • 
                                                    
  • Bulk assignment supported
    • 
                                                    
  • Picker capacity considered
    • 
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
4. Pick Release

                                                
Execute pick release in Oracle Fusion to create pick tasks.

                                                
    
                                                    
  • Calls Fusion pick wave API
    • 
                                                    
  • Creates warehouse tasks
    • 
                                                    
  • Status updated in real-time
    • 
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
5. Allocate Lots

                                                
Allocate specific inventory lots to the order lines.

                                                
    
                                                    
  • Fetch available lots from Fusion
    • 
                                                    
  • Automatic or manual allocation
    • 
                                                    
  • FIFO/FEFO support
    • 
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
6. Print Pick List

                                                
Generate and print pick lists for the warehouse team.

                                                
    
                                                    
  • Auto-print or manual print
    • 
                                                    
  • PDF preview available
    • 
                                                    
  • Batch printing supported
    • 
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
7. Confirm Pick

                                                
Confirm picking completion and update status.

                                                
    
                                                    
  • Update pick confirm status
    • 
                                                    
  • Process S2V transactions
    • 
                                                    
  • Ready for dispatch
    • 
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    
 Store to Vehicle (S2V) Transaction Process

                                    

                                        
The S2V process moves inventory from the store/warehouse to the delivery vehicle.

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
1

                                            

                                                Create S2V Request
                                                
Generate transfer request

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            
2

                                            

                                                Fetch Lot Details
                                                
Get available lots

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            
3

                                            

                                                Allocate Lots
                                                
Assign lots to request

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            
4

                                            

                                                Process Transaction
                                                
Execute in Fusion

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            
5

                                            

                                                Complete
                                                
Update status

    •

Auto Sales Order Processing

    •

    • 
                                                
  • Scheduled lines management
    • 
                                                
  • Progress tracking and reporting
    •

    •

 Getting Started with WMS

                                
Welcome to the Warehouse Management System. This guide will walk you through the basics of navigating the application, understanding the dashboard, and performing your first operations.


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Overview Video

                                        
A walkthrough video of the WMS application will be available here.

                                        
                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
Login to the Application

                                            
Launch the WMS desktop application. You will be automatically logged in based on your Windows credentials. The application connects to Oracle Fusion Cloud via secure REST APIs.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Login Screen
                                            The application launches with a login screen showing your instance (TEST/PROD)
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            Tip: Make sure you select the correct instance (TEST for testing, PROD for live operations) before proceeding.
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Understanding the Dashboard

                                            
After login, you arrive at the Trip Management screen. This is your main workspace showing all trips, orders, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Main Dashboard - Trip Management
                                            The Trip Management page shows query parameters, trip list grid, and KPI cards at the top
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Query Parameters
                                                
Filter trips by date, instance, and status. Click the header to expand/collapse.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Trip Grid
                                                
All trips displayed in a sortable, filterable grid. Click a trip to view details.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                KPI Cards
                                                
Summary stats: total trips, orders, customers, lorries, and weight at a glance.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Navigating the Sidebar Menu

                                            
The left sidebar contains all the main sections of the application. Click on any menu item to navigate to that section.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Sidebar Navigation Menu
                                            Left sidebar with Trip Management, Vehicles, Analytics, Pickers, Printing, and Settings menus
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
 Trip Management - Create, view, and manage trips

                                        
 Vehicles Dashboard - Monitor vehicle fleet status

                                        
 Analytics - View charts and performance metrics

                                        
 Pickers - Manage warehouse picker assignments

                                        
 Monitor Printing - Track print jobs and statuses

                                        
 Auto Processing - Inventory and Sales Order automation

                                        
 Settings - Configure application preferences

                                    

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                
 Create a New Trip

                                
Learn how to create a new trip from start to finish. A trip groups sales orders together for delivery on a specific vehicle on a scheduled date.


                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Create Trip - Video Tutorial

                                        
Watch how to create a new trip step by step.

                                        
                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
Open the Create Trip Dialog

                                            
From the Trip Management page, click the "Create Trip" button located in the toolbar above the trip grid.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Click "Create Trip" Button
                                            The Create Trip button is in the toolbar area, usually with a blue/primary color and a "+" icon
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            Tip: You can also use the Auto Pilot feature to create trips automatically. See the "Auto Pilot" training module.
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Fill in the New Trip Details Popup

                                            
A popup dialog appears where you enter the trip details. Fill in each required field:

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            New Trip Details Popup
                                            The dialog shows fields for Trip Date, Lorry selection, Instance, and other trip parameters
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                                

                                                    Field
                                                    Description
                                                    Required
                                                

                                            
                                            
                                                

                                                    Trip Date
                                                    Select the delivery date for this trip. Defaults to today's date.
                                                    Required
                                                

                                                

                                                    Lorry / Vehicle
                                                    Choose the vehicle for this trip from the dropdown. Shows lorry number and capacity.
                                                    Required
                                                

                                                

                                                    Instance
                                                    Select the Oracle Fusion instance (TEST or PROD).
                                                    Required
                                                

                                                

                                                    Priority
                                                    Set trip priority: High, Medium, or Low.
                                                    Optional
                                                

                                            
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Submit and Open the Trip

                                            
Click "Create Trip" to submit. The system will create the trip in the database and open a new trip tab showing the trip details with KPI cards. The trip starts with zero orders - you'll add orders in the next step.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Trip Created Successfully
                                            A new tab opens showing the trip with header KPI cards (Trip Date, Lorry, Orders: 0, Volume capacity bar) and an empty orders area with "Add Orders" button
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            What you'll see: The trip tab shows summary KPI cards at the top (Trip Date, Lorry, Orders, Customers, Quantity, Volume capacity bar, Products, Priority) and a grid area below. For a new trip, the grid shows "No Orders Yet" with an "Add Orders" button.
                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                
 Trip Details View

                                
Understand the trip details tab - the KPI header cards, the orders grid, and all available actions for managing a trip.


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
Opening Trip Details

                                            
From the Trip Management grid, click on any Trip ID link (highlighted in blue) to open the trip details in a new tab.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Click Trip ID in Grid
                                            The Trip ID column in the grid has clickable links that open a detailed view for each trip
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Trip Summary KPI Cards

                                            
The top section of the trip tab displays summary statistics. Click the header to expand/collapse this section.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Trip Summary KPI Cards
                                            Header section showing Trip Date, Lorry, Total Orders, Customers, Quantity, Volume with capacity progress bar, Products, and Priority
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            
Trip Date
The scheduled delivery date

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            
Lorry
Assigned vehicle number

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            
Orders
Total number of sales orders

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            
Customers
Unique customer count

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            
Quantity
Total item quantity across orders

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            
Volume (m³)
Filled vs capacity with progress bar

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            
Products
Unique product count

                                        

                                        

                                            
                                            
Priority
Trip priority (High/Medium/Low)

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Orders Grid & Actions Toolbar

                                            
Below the KPI cards, you'll find the orders grid listing all sales orders in this trip, along with action buttons.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Orders Grid with Action Buttons
                                            Grid showing order number, customer, items, status, picker, with buttons: Refresh, Assign Picker, Allocate Lots, Pick Release All, Show Lines, Add Orders
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                             Refresh
                                            Reload trip data from the server to see latest changes
                                        

                                        

                                             Assign Picker
                                            Assign a warehouse picker to selected orders
                                        

                                        

                                             Allocate Lots
                                            Allocate inventory lots for Ship-to-Verify orders
                                        

                                        

                                             Pick Release All
                                            Release all orders in the trip for picking
                                        

                                        

                                             Show Lines
                                            View detailed order lines for all orders in the trip
                                        

                                        

                                             Add Orders
                                            Open the Add Orders modal to add more orders to this trip
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
4

                                        

                                            
Using the Grid Features

                                            
The DevExpress grid has powerful built-in features for sorting, filtering, searching, and exporting data.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Sort Columns
                                                
Click any column header to sort ascending/descending.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Filter Rows
                                                
Use the filter row below column headers to filter by specific values.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Search Panel
                                                
Use the search box at the top right of the grid to search across all columns.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Select Orders
                                                
Use checkboxes to select multiple orders for batch actions.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Export to Excel
                                                
Click the export button to download grid data as an Excel file.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Resize & Reorder
                                                
Drag column headers to reorder, and drag column edges to resize.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                
 Adding Orders to a Trip

                                
Learn how to add sales orders to an existing trip. You can select from available unassigned orders using the Add Orders modal, configure which columns to display, and add single or multiple orders.


                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Add Orders to Trip - Video Tutorial

                                        
Watch how to search and add orders to a trip.

                                        
                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
Open the Add Orders Modal

                                            
From within a trip details tab, click the "Add Orders" button in the toolbar. This opens a modal overlay showing available orders that haven't been assigned to any trip.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Click "Add Orders" Button
                                            The "Add Orders" button is in the trip details toolbar, shown in blue/primary color
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Configure Visible Columns

                                            
The Add Orders modal allows you to choose which columns to display. Click the "Columns" or column chooser button to select/deselect columns. Common columns include:

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Column Selector / Chooser
                                            A dropdown or panel showing checkboxes for each available column: Order Number, Customer, Ship-To, Items, Weight, Volume, Status, etc.
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                                

                                                    Column
                                                    Description
                                                    Useful For
                                                

                                            
                                            
                                                

                                                    ORDER_NUMBER
                                                    The sales order number from Oracle Fusion
                                                    Identifying specific orders
                                                

                                                

                                                    ACCOUNT_NAME
                                                    Customer / account name
                                                    Grouping by customer for delivery routes
                                                

                                                

                                                    SHIP_TO_ADDRESS
                                                    Delivery destination address
                                                    Planning delivery routes
                                                

                                                

                                                    ORDER_VOLUME
                                                    Volume of the order in m³
                                                    Checking if order fits in lorry capacity
                                                

                                                

                                                    TOTAL_ITEMS
                                                    Number of line items in the order
                                                    Estimating pick time
                                                

                                                

                                                    LINE_STATUS
                                                    Current order status
                                                    Filtering by readiness
                                                

                                            
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            Tip: You can drag column headers in the grid to reorder them. Your column preferences may be saved for future sessions.
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Search and Filter Orders

                                            
Use the filter row and search panel to find specific orders. You can filter by customer name, order number, address, or any other visible column.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Filtering Orders in the Add Orders Grid
                                            Filter row below column headers, and search box at top right, used to narrow down the orders list
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
4

                                        

                                            
Select and Add Orders to the Trip

                                            
Select one or more orders using the checkboxes, then click "Add Selected Orders" to add them to the trip. The system will call the API to assign each selected order to the trip.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Select Orders and Click "Add Selected"
                                            Checkboxes selected on multiple rows, with "Add Selected Orders to Trip" button at the bottom of the modal
                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            After adding: The modal closes and you can click "Refresh" on the trip details tab to see the newly added orders in the grid. The KPI cards (Orders, Customers, Volume, etc.) will also update.
                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                
 Auto Pilot Mode

                                
Auto Pilot automates the entire trip creation and order assignment process. It can automatically process inventory transactions, sales orders, create trips, and assign orders based on configured rules.


                                

                                    

                                        
                                        
Auto Pilot - Video Tutorial

                                        
See Auto Pilot in action creating trips and assigning orders automatically.

                                        
                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
What is Auto Pilot?

                                            
Auto Pilot is an automation feature that runs a sequence of warehouse processes end-to-end without manual intervention. It handles:

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            
Process Inventory Transactions

                                            
Auto-processes pending inventory items

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            
Process Sales Orders

                                            
Auto-processes pending sales orders

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            
Create Trips

                                            
Creates trips for delivery scheduling

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            
Assign Orders

                                            
Assigns orders to trips automatically

                                        

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            
Pick Release

                                            
Releases orders for warehouse picking

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Navigate to Auto Processing

                                            
Click "Auto Inventory Processing" or "Auto Sales Order Processing" in the sidebar menu to access the automation controls.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Auto Processing Page
                                            The auto processing page shows the current status, processing queue, start/stop controls, and processing logs
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Start Auto Pilot Processing

                                            
Click the "Start" button to begin automated processing. The system will process items in the queue one by one, showing real-time progress and logs.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            Important: Auto Pilot processes real data. Always test in the TEST instance first before running on PROD. Monitor the logs to ensure processing is working correctly.
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
4

                                        

                                            
Monitor and Review Results

                                            
Watch the processing logs for success/error messages. Once complete, go back to Trip Management to see the newly created trips and assigned orders.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Success
                                                
Green log entries indicate successful processing.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Errors
                                                
Red entries show errors. Check the message for details.

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Retry
                                                
Failed items can be retried by restarting the process.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                
 Pick Release Process

                                
Pick Release sends orders to the warehouse for physical picking. This creates pick tasks that pickers can work on using the Picker View.


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
Select Orders for Pick Release

                                            
Open a trip details tab and select the orders you want to release using the checkboxes in the grid.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            Tip: Use "Pick Release All" to release all orders in the trip at once, or select specific orders for partial release.
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Assign a Picker (Optional)

                                            
Before or after pick release, you can assign a picker to the orders. Click "Assign Picker" and select a picker from the dropdown.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Assign Picker Dialog
                                            A dialog showing a picker dropdown and the selected orders. Choose a picker and confirm.
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Click Pick Release All

                                            
Click "Pick Release All" in the trip toolbar. The system calls the Oracle Fusion API to create pick tasks for each order. Progress is shown in real-time.

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
4

                                        

                                            
Verify in Picker View

                                            
After pick release, pickers can open "Picker View" from the sidebar to see their assigned pick tasks and start picking items in the warehouse.

                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                
 Printing & Documents

                                
The WMS supports printing store transaction documents, delivery notes, and pick lists. Documents can be printed directly from the trip details grid.


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
Print from Trip Details

                                            
Each order row in the trip details grid has a print icon () in the Actions column. Click it to print the store transaction document for that order.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            Print Icon in Actions Column
                                            Each row has a purple print icon that generates and prints the store transaction PDF
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Monitor Print Jobs

                                            
Navigate to "Monitor Printing" in the sidebar to see all print jobs, their statuses, and any errors.

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Configure Printers

                                            
Go to "Printer Setups" to configure available printers, set default printers, and manage print preferences.

                                        

                                    

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                
 Managing Vehicles & Pickers

                                
Learn how to manage your vehicle fleet and warehouse picker team. Vehicles define delivery capacity, and pickers handle order fulfillment in the warehouse.


                                
                                

                                     Vehicles
                                


                                

                                    

                                        
1

                                        

                                            
View Vehicle Dashboard

                                            
Click "Vehicles Dashboard" in the sidebar to see an overview of your entire fleet - availability, capacity utilization, and trip assignments.

                                        

                                    

                                


                                

                                    

                                        
2

                                        

                                            
Manage Vehicles

                                            
Click "Vehicles" in the sidebar to add, edit, or remove vehicles. Each vehicle has a lorry number, registration, and volume capacity (m³).

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                     Pickers
                                


                                

                                    

                                        
3

                                        

                                            
Manage Pickers

                                            
Click "Pickers" in the sidebar to view, add, or edit warehouse pickers. Pickers are assigned to orders within trips.

                                        

                                    

                                


                                

                                    

                                        
4

                                        

                                            
Picker View (Mobile/Tablet)

                                            
Click "Picker View" to open the picker-facing interface. This is designed for warehouse floor use on tablets/mobile devices, showing assigned pick tasks for the logged-in picker.

                                        

                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            Mobile-friendly: Picker View opens in a separate page optimized for touch screens and smaller devices used on the warehouse floor.
